asian_handicap.definition: HOME bet at Bet365 HandiSize (added to home goals). Quarter lines split the stake over the two neighbouring lines. Model/market probabilities are P(win | not pushed); log loss / Brier / ECE are weighted by the decided stake fraction.

btts.note: no BTTS odds in the dataset: model calibration vs realised only

team_totals.note: no team-total odds in the dataset: calibration only
